verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers sandbox lifecycle features such as scale-to-zero, sub-25ms resume, snapshots and expiration. It never documents running large concurrent sandbox fleets or publishing concurrency limits or quotas. Parallel batch Jobs and a drive mountable to multiple sandboxes are separate features and do not transfer to this sandbox-fleet concurrency story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits
